articles.summary: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. (NYSE: IVR) (the "Company") today announced that the Company declared a cash dividend of $0.12 per share of common stock for the month of May 2026. The dividend will be paid on June 12, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on May 26, 2026, with an ex-dividend date of May 26, 2026.
